show_gpu_usage.label: GPU usage
show_gpu_usage.description: Auto shows this when a GPU reporting usage is detected.

show_gpu_temperature.label: GPU temperature
show_gpu_temperature.description: Auto shows this when a GPU reporting temperature is detected.

show_gpu_vram.label: GPU VRAM usage
show_gpu_vram.description: Auto shows this when a GPU reporting VRAM usage is detected.

show_cpu_details_in_tooltip.label: CPU details in tooltip
show_cpu_details_in_tooltip.description: Show CPU usage, temperature, frequency, and load in the tooltip. Off by default since the bar already shows enabled CPU metrics.

show_top_processes.label: Top processes in tooltip
show_top_processes.description: Show the highest CPU and RAM consumers reported by ps.

compact_network.label: Compact network units
compact_network.description: Use short labels such as M/s instead of MB/s.

network_interface.label: Network interface
network_interface.description: Exact interface name to monitor. Leave empty for total non-loopback traffic.

disk_path.label: Disk path
disk_path.description: Filesystem path whose disk usage should be displayed.
